title: Egyptian Fritter Fruit Dessert
description: A warm and crispy Egyptian-inspired dessert made with fritters and fresh fruit. Enjoy as a sweet treat any time of the year.
instructions: Heat the fritters according to the package instructions.
Mix the powdered sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice in a bowl.
In a separate pan, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the mixed fruit to the pan and heat for 2-3 minutes.
Dip each fritter into the warm honey and then coat with the powdered sugar mixture.
Place a fritter on a crispy wafer and top with a spoonful of the mixed fruit.
Drizzle the warm honey over the top and serve immediately.
Repeat the process until all the ingredients have been used.
